name: scholar-research
description: Source-grounded academic literature answers using only free scholarly APIs (OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, arXiv, PubMed, Europe PMC, Unpaywall, DataCite) and your own Claude subscription. Every claim gets a [P#] citation tag; every citation passes a double gate (DOI/title/author/year/retraction machine check + claim-to-excerpt matching). Includes project mode (paper tables, RIS/BibTeX/XLSX export, citation graph, peer-review packet), one-shot `bundle` search with local sqlite cache, and a [W#] primary-data layer (FRED / World Bank time series with a vintage ledger). Zero operating cost.
